newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.2 Dec 6 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.2 Dec 6 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) fell to 106.2 in the week ended December 6 from a revised 106.4 the previous week, ECRI said.
Slower growth in real estate loans and a widening of the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries helped push the index up, ECRI said.
"The relative stability in the FIG suggests that on balance, inflation pressures are not on the rise."
